additional_concerns: Exposure measurement and designation verification are supplied judgments, not implemented assessments. The formula alone cannot establish that either input correctly reflects the Fund.

Footnote 7 situates the holistic designation assessment below 50% of NAV. The unrestricted OR preserves the classification result when exposure is known to meet the automatic threshold; it must not be interpreted as implementing the SFC’s discretionary assessment.

The rule does not impose an exhaustive instrument list or classify a Fund merely because it holds a named instrument. However, its external exposure assessment must preserve the non-exhaustive examples and distinguish the Fund from intermediary investments.

Conflict blocking across every dependency is an operational restriction beyond the circular: it can prevent a result even when an independently established route suffices. This preserves an unresolved evaluation rather than establishing a negative classification.

A FALSE result concerns only the retained routes at the assessment occasion. Neither declassification after exposure falls nor the duration or revocation of an earlier designation is established by the supplied text.
The supplied missing dependency IDs have no authority-name mapping. No catalogue association can be established from their identifiers alone.
